review.decision: Internal remediation materialization records the exact baseline-to-current ownership assignments and exact-inventory transitions enumerated below. The reviewed current denominator includes the accepted AI Calls Stage 1–5 runtime/proof files and source-isolated mass-calling migration under Calling ownership, the reconciled current-main Telegram link restoration under existing Telegram Channel and Fleet Operations paths, the two exact native Codex Stage 0 skill metadata files under repository_operations ownership, three bounded MAX outbound test surfaces under the existing gravity_root exclusion and gravity_application_operations owner, nine intentional Telegram driver-link source/test surfaces introduced together at commit 50d786e6711d7ad5d53da00f361a32e7f470821c, and twenty-three intentional AI call campaign product surfaces introduced by PR #79. The campaign set is exactly twenty-two Calling-owned application, contract, route, UI, adapter, and test surfaces under existing Calling owned-path selectors plus one source-only MIGRATION surface under the existing gravity_schema exclusion and gravity_application_operations owner. The complete Stage A set additionally adds exactly fourteen tracked executable surfaces: one content-specific CI workflow under ci_workflow, twelve release builder/verifier/test surfaces under architecture_recovery, and one authoritative control under architecture_controls; the eleven operational surfaces have exact lifecycle classifications and the three tests retain TEST lifecycle. The combined current-main integration adds thirty-seven disjoint tracked executable surfaces relative to the accepted base, retains their Git modes and existing owner selectors, adds no exact-runtime or exact-path inventory transition, and grants no production migration, live provider, billing, deployment, telephony, real-call, credential, or application-data authority. The declared current-dependency manifest prevents test-source literals from becoming a second authority; this artifact is not external or independent acceptance. The PR #81 Driver / Contact / Channel Identity candidate adds exactly five reviewed legacy Gravity runtime composition entrypoints to the frozen exact inventory: three Contacts API routes, one Fleet-check API route, and one automatic-merge composition module. These paths preserve the existing finite legacy runtime owner assignment while their business mutations remain governed by the accepted Contacts and Fleet public boundaries; this transition grants no production migration, live-provider, credential, deployment, telephony, or application-data authority. The PR #81 conflict-repair follow-up adds exactly eighty-two tracked executable surfaces: fifty-one are context-owned (seventeen APPLICATION_RUNTIME and thirty-four TEST) under Calling, Contacts, Fleet Operations, Identity Access, MAX Channel, Messaging, Platform Shell, Telegram Channel, WhatsApp Channel, and Work Management, while thirty-one TEST surfaces remain under the existing gravity_root exclusion. It changes reviewed bytes for exactly thirty-six already-assigned legacy Gravity runtime paths without changing their lifecycle, owner, exclusion, or frozen 247-path exact-runtime denominator. This ownership classification grants no additional production-migration, credential, deployment, telephony, or application-data authority; live-provider behavior remains constrained by the existing channel owners and the reviewed fail-closed account and transport proofs. The final architecture-boundary repair moves exactly four already-reviewed context-owned executable paths—two APPLICATION_RUNTIME and two TEST—from internal to application layers under their unchanged MAX Channel and Platform Shell owners. It also attenuates transaction callback results at the Contacts reachability and Messaging matched-driver persistence boundaries, declares the existing MAX webhook secret in the MAX Channel manifest, and updates exact path assertions. The executable denominator remains 2,427, these moves cause no exact-runtime or exact-path inventory transition, and one already-assigned legacy Gravity runtime source hash changes without changing lifecycle, owner, exclusion, or the frozen 247-path exact-runtime denominator. This repair grants no additional production-migration, credential, deployment, telephony, provider, or application-data authority.
